Mark tag produces highlighted output

```typescript title="WebAssembly"
import { convert } from "@xberg-io/html-to-markdown-wasm";
function main() {
  const result = convert("<p>This is <mark>highlighted text</mark> in a sentence.</p>");
  console.log(result);
}

void main();
```
